title: Page open-work line landed; its refresh waits on one Servex restart

owner_note.text: Every page now shows "N open tasks on this page" and page.previews(pages, {weight:true, min}) ranks and sizes cards by weight (display A, a size scale, chosen; B is the alternative). Still open: nothing refreshes ai/page-work.json on a timer, so it only updates when someone runs `node Server/page-ai-cost.mjs --work` (smallest next step: call it from Servex's task tick, then one batched restart proven on a private port); and an Item or card has only a `weight` property, no weight.jsonl of its own.
